traits.name: Emotionally Unaware
traits.text: The android takes a –1 circumstance penalty to Diplomacy and Performance checks, and to Perception checks to Sense Motive.

traits.name: Nanite Surge
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger The android infiltrator attempts a skill check but hasn't rolled yet Effect The android infiltrator stimulates their nanites, forcing their body to temporarily increase its efficiency. They gain a +2 status bonus to the triggering skill check. In addition, their circuitry glows, creating a 10-foot emanation with dim light for 1 round.

traits.name: Sneak Attack
traits.text: The android infiltrator deals an additional 1d6 (1d6) precision damage to flatfooted creatures.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ shortsword +10 (agile, finesse, versatile s); Damage 1d6+2 (1d6+2) piercing

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ hand crossbow +10 (range increment 60 feet, reload 1); Damage 1d6 (1d6) piercing
